== Title ==
<span lang="ja">飛行経路チェック</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">「デス・スター：トレンチ」に配備する。敵はトレンチを出る宇宙戦闘機の飛行経路チェックを行わねばならない。各宇宙戦闘機について、それぞれ運命数を引く。運命数＋回避値＜5なら、宇宙戦闘機はロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「ルーク、スピードを上げすぎたら、機体を立て直せなくなるぞ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Maneuver Check]].

'''Lore''' — Luke, if you raise the speed too much, you will not be able to pull the craft out.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on Death Star: Trench. Opponent must make a flight-path check for starfighters leaving the trench. For each starfighter, draw destiny. If destiny plus maneuver is less than 5, the starfighter is lost.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed title is 飛行経路チェック. Lore is a warning about too much speed, not a question about pulling out in time. Game text draws destiny for each starfighter and does not say the owner draws. Uses 回避値 for maneuver.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-maneuvercheck.gif|Original English face]], [[Maneuver Check]].</ref>
